**Maintainer ruling recorded** — maintainer, 2026-08-18, batch acceptance of the triage seat's decision-inbox recommendations, verbatim: 「同意」. Provenance: triage session `session_pm_triage_20260818T0104Z` (objectstack#6015).

**Ruled: the 27 keys are HOST surface, exempted with reasons — not authored surface.** Basis: measured reachability — the `renderListView` delegation branch is entered only when a host supplies the prop, the registered renderer does not, and the sole in-tree supplier is app-shell; the schema-registration path documented to authors cannot reach these keys, so declaring them on `ObjectViewSchema` would promise authors a surface that does nothing on their path.

This card's work: record the exemption where the next sweep looks — a comment block at the forwarding site enumerating the 27 keys as host-composition surface with this ruling's date, and the docs guidance that they are ⛔ not to be taught as schema keys. The structural follow-through (typing the forwarding block as an explicit host-side prop contract so host surface and authored surface are separated in types, retiring the `(schema as any)` reads) belongs to the #5043 family track, not this card.

Label `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke.

## Zone 1 — ruled, and the ruling also bounds the card

Maintainer, 2026-08-18, batch acceptance, verbatim 「同意」:

> **Ruled: the 27 keys are HOST surface, exempted with reasons — not authored surface.** Basis: measured reachability — the `renderListView` delegation branch is entered only when a host supplies the prop, the registered renderer does not, and the sole in-tree supplier is app-shell; the schema-registration path documented to authors cannot reach these keys, so declaring them on `ObjectViewSchema` would promise authors a surface that does nothing on their path.
>
> This card's work: record the exemption where the next sweep looks — a comment block at the forwarding site enumerating the 27 keys as host-composition surface with this ruling's date, and the docs guidance that they are ⛔ not to be taught as schema keys. The structural follow-through (typing the forwarding block as an explicit host-side prop contract so host surface and authored surface are separated in types, retiring the `(schema as any)` reads) belongs to the #5043 family track, not this card.

Two things follow, both binding:

1. ⛔ **Do not declare any of the 27 on `ObjectViewSchema`**, and ⛔ do not remove any read. The ruling is "exempt with reasons", not "fix".
2. ⛔ **Do not retire the `(schema as any)` reads or introduce a host-side prop contract.** That is explicitly assigned to the **#5043 family track**, not here. It will be tempting — it is the "real" fix — and taking it would put this card in conflict with a track that owns it.

## ⛔ Re-verify the ruling's own basis before you rely on it

The ruling rests on a **measured reachability claim**: the registered renderer `ObjectViewRenderer` (`src/index.tsx:58-66`) does not pass `renderListView`, and the only non-test in-tree supplier is `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:1618`.

**Re-run that enumeration on current `main` before writing a word of the comment block.** If a second supplier now exists, the ruling's basis has moved and you must stop and report rather than recording a rationale that is no longer true.

This is not hypothetical caution. **Earlier today the ruling on the sibling card #5091 was found to rest on a falsified premise** — it asserted `rowActionDefs` was the symmetric partner of a declared `bulkActionDefs`, and measurement showed the spec rejects it by name and the host derives it. That half is back with the maintainer. A ruling's premises go stale exactly like a card body's, and read more authoritative while doing it.

Same for the key list: the card enumerates 31 reads (4 declared, 27 not) at base `9fbb9b52f`. **Re-derive the list yourself** — the count and the membership are the substance of the comment block, and `plugin-view` has changed since (PR5231 landed in this file's package today). Report any difference from the card's 27.

## ⛔ The trap — `rowActionDefs` appears in BOTH cards and they are NOT the same question

`rowActionDefs` is in this card's 27-key list **and** is the one unresolved key on #5091.

They are different questions about different components, and the answers may legitimately differ:
- **Here**: a key on the ObjectView node forwarded to a host-supplied renderer — ruled **host surface** by the ruling above, along with the other 26.
- **On #5091**: a key on the ObjectGrid node, where the question is whether it enters `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`. **Still open with the maintainer.**

⛔ Do not let #5091's open state block this card, and ⛔ do not import a conclusion from here to there. Treat `rowActionDefs` as one of the 27, exactly like its neighbours, and say in your report that you did.

## The pattern to copy — it already exists, merged, today

**PR5241** landed the sibling exemption for `plugin-grid` about an hour ago and its body writes out the reusable pattern explicitly, for this card by name. Read it. In particular:

- The comment carries four elements: the verdict in words a sweep from the manifest side will land on; the **ruling that made it deliberate** (maintainer, date, issue); **who supplies the key, as `file:line`** — that is what makes "host surface" checkable rather than an opinion; and the contract's verdict plus a pointer to the test.
- The test's fourth assertion per key is the one that matters most: **the renderer still reads it.** Deleting a read is the one move that silently blanks a stored document, and it is what a future reader of "not authored surface" will think is the tidy finish.
- Nothing is owed to the repo-wide `registry-inputs-spec-parity` gate for a key the spec does not declare — that gate derives expectations from `ComponentPropsMap`, so it never demands them in reverse.

**Adapt, do not transcribe.** #5091's keys were non-author because they are user-state or host switches; these 27 are host surface because **the authored registration path cannot reach the branch at all**. The rationale differs even though the shape matches, and the comment must state *this* card's reason.

## Tests

27 keys is too many for four assertions each without the suite becoming noise. Pin the **property**, not the enumeration:

- The forwarded key set equals the documented 27 (derive from one exported constant so the list has a single home, and the test fails by name when a read is added or removed without touching it).
- The delegation branch is unreachable through the registered renderer — i.e. `ObjectViewRenderer` does not supply `renderListView`. This is the ruling's basis; pin it so a future change that starts supplying it fails loudly instead of silently promoting 27 keys to the authored path.
- The reads still happen: at least a representative sample forwards through to the host renderer.

Reverse-verify: predict which assertions go red before running, and report predicted vs observed.

## Gates

Derive from your diff. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is **objectstack-only** — here derive from `.github/workflows` and `package.json`. If the change is comments plus a test only, an empty-frontmatter changeset is the precedent PR5241 set — run `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and follow its verdict. ⛔ Never `major`.

⛔ **Do not background a long check and end your turn.** Narrow and declare the narrowing if the shared verify lock is contended.

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`, first body line `Fixes #5097`. Push the branch early. Return the JSON report and post it as a comment whose first line is the literal `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker.
